title: Littlest Tokyo
description: A scroll-driven camera tour of an animated town: a dive down a spline into an alley, a shot that keeps the running mascot in frame, a ride on the tram and a long lens on the birds, with depth of field following each shot and speed lines on the drop. Cameras by @pmndrs/klipp.
